feed.headline: Protesters blame 'vulture funds' for Spain's housing crisis
feed.ai: Hundreds have pitched their tents in central Madrid, while the Spanish prime minister has called a snap election.

feed.headline: Analysis: Trump's shock Russia deal highlights mounting pressure to curb fuel prices
feed.ai: The US president hopes to ease his party's pain before next month's midterm elections, writes the BBC's North America correspondent.

feed.headline: Spain PM pins hopes on housing crisis to help win snap election
feed.ai: Calling of a snap election was not a knee-jerk reaction from Pedro Sánchez but a carefully thought-out manoeuvre, Guy Hedgecoe reports from Madrid.

feed.headline: Amsterdam’s Van Gogh Museum Says It Reached Funding Deal and Won’t Have to Close
feed.ai: In a yearslong dispute, the Amsterdam institution pressed the Dutch government for an increased annual subsidy to pay for what the museum said were vital renovations.

feed.headline: Poland detains man suspected of planning assassination of PM Tusk
feed.ai: Police received credible information about possible attacks against Donald Tusk and his defence minister.

feed.headline: 'Stain on the country': Trump criticises Norway over Nobel Peace Prize
feed.ai: The US president told a rally he had "never heard of" the winner, former International Criminal Court judge Navi Pillay.

feed.headline: Russian strikes and approaching winter force some in Kyiv to pack bags and flee
feed.ai: A renewed Russian campaign of strikes on power and energy infrastructure has made some contemplate leaving Ukraine's capital.

feed.headline: Nord Stream trial: How German police followed the evidence - to Ukraine
feed.ai: After four years, a Ukrainian man is set to stand trial in Hamburg accused of sabotaging the Nord Stream pipelines.

feed.headline: Watch: What could Trump's energy ceasefire mean for Ukraine?
feed.ai: The BBC's Dan Johnson reports from Kyiv, where Ukrainians face another winter with electricity outages.

feed.headline: NATO Details Plan to Shield Ukraine’s European Allies from Russia
feed.ai: With the Russians intensifying sabotage, arson and cyberattacks against European nations supporting Ukraine, NATO divulged a blueprint, in case of war, to deter the Kremlin.

feed.headline: Trump Gives Putin a Hand in Russia’s Economic War With Ukraine
feed.ai: President Trump is moving to buy Russian diesel while also pressuring Ukraine to halt attacks on refineries, a lifeblood of Moscow’s war machine.

feed.headline: Ukraine Shrugs Off Trump Call to Ditch Zelensky for Energy Strikes
feed.ai: President Trump lashed out at President Volodymyr Zelensky for striking Russian oil refineries. Mr. Zelensky said he’ll stop — if Russia does too.
